description: What RimWorld 1.7's own threads do, for rimworld-perf's thread names: a thread takes the first-listed name whose methods hold the most of its sampled time, at least 30%. * and ? are wildcards over Namespace.Type.Method. Read from the owner's three recordings of 17 and 18 November 2026 (RimWorld 1.7.5011 on Waylith, Ludeon's engine); .NET's own threads are named in the kit's core (sampling.DOTNET_THREADS).
threads: the render thread (the engine drawing frames)
